_comment: Provenance of the test suites that carry the P0-2 verdict. The point of this file is that 'a suite of adversarial tests passes' is not one claim but two: who wrote the tests, and whether the party that raised the findings has confirmed them independently. Recording the second as ABSENT is what keeps a reconstructed suite from being read as reviewer confirmation.

provenance_kinds.leo-authored: written in this repository against the behaviour it specifies
provenance_kinds.reconstructed: independently rebuilt from a third party's written description of a failure, without their test file
provenance_kinds.reviewer-original: supplied by the reviewing party; the only kind that constitutes independent confirmation

statuses.PRESENT: the file is in this repository and runs
statuses.ABSENT: not in this repository; NOT PROVIDED by the party that referenced it
statuses.SUPERSEDED: kept for history, no longer run

suites.covers: P0-2 Case A-E, run/task binding, manifest shape
P0-2 evidence-chain integrity: state, schema, artifacts, history, version compatibility, path safety
must_not: be renamed to the reviewer-original file name
be deleted or shrunk when the reviewer's own file arrives
be described anywhere as the reviewer's tests
suites.source_sha256_note: Records which bytes the '32 of 41 fail on the pre-fix kernel' evidence was measured against. It is informational: editing the file's docstring changes it, and the guarantee that matters is locked_test_functions, which is enforced.

suites.note: Referenced by the review but never supplied. When it arrives it must be added at the reserved path and both suites run. It does not replace the reconstructed one.

suites.covers: the two review statements that were wrong as written (missing stage document -> re-run, changed prompt -> incompatible-but-auditable), and the run/manifest/history properties around them
suites.evidence: 15 of 20 fail against docs/rollback/research-sop-kernel.pre-P0-2-round2.py; 20 of 20 against pre-P0-2

suites.covers: each evidence-chain guarantee is load-bearing: one guarantee is removed per case and the property must break
suites.evidence: 6 of 7 mutants are killed; the seventh -- relabelling a corrupt manifest as missing -- survives because sop_run_branches finds the run by directory contents rather than by manifest validity. The surviving mutant is recorded in the file, with a second mutation that does break the property

pending_confirmations.effect_on_gate: P0-2 stays PASS on the evidence in this repository. Independent confirmation by the reviewing party is a separate thing and has not happened. This is carried as a release caveat until their file is run here.

_counting: minimum_test_functions counts `def test_*` in the file. minimum_collected_cases counts what pytest actually runs, which is larger wherever @pytest.mark.parametrize expands one function into several. The headline '41 adversarial tests' is a collected-case count, and both numbers are recorded so neither can be quoted as the other.
